disclaimer.short: Information and guidance grounded in cited sources — not legal advice, and not a substitute for a qualified professional.
disclaimer.prototype: Smart India Hackathon prototype · problem statement SIH26045. Not an official government service.

notAvailable.title: Not available yet
notAvailable.body: This screen shows where the feature will be. Nothing here works yet, and nothing shown here is legal information.
notAvailable.whenReady: When it is ready, this area will:

ask.title: Ask
ask.description: Ask a question about intellectual property or regulation for an Ayurvedic product.

points.one: Quote the official text each answer relies on, with its source and date.
points.two: Answer Indian and international material separately, never mixed together.
points.three: Say so when the sources do not support an answer, and offer a human facilitator instead.

classify.title: Classify
classify.description: Answer a few fixed questions about one of your products and see which category your answers lead to.

points.one: Ask about your product one question at a time, and show why each question was asked.
points.two: Show the category your own answers lead to — never a legal determination.

myProduct.title: My Products
myProduct.description: Describe your products. What you write here is your own description, not a classification.

points.one: Hold the product or formulation name, its ingredients and its intended purpose.
points.two: Hold formulation details and manufacturing information.
points.three: Hold source documents you choose to attach.

myProduct.note: A profile describes your product. It is never treated as a legal classification.

escalate.title: Escalate
escalate.description: When the sources are not enough, send your question to a person.

points.one: Send your question to a human IP facilitator.
points.two: Show the facilitator's reply as theirs, with their name and role.

incoming.title: Incoming escalations
incoming.description: Questions users have sent to a facilitator.

points.two: Show for each what the user asked, and what the sources did and did not support.

brief.title: Brief
brief.description: Everything about one escalation, in one place.

points.one: Bring together the question, the user's product profile and the sources already found.
Carry your replies to the user, shown as yours and with your role.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Your private notes on an escalation.

points.one: Keep working notes on an escalation that only facilitators can see.

corpus.title: Corpus
corpus.description: Official source documents and the provisions taken from them. Only approved text can ever be used.

points.one: List every official source document with its issuing authority, retrieval date and fingerprint.
points.two: Make sure only approved text is ever quoted to users.

upload.title: Upload
upload.description: Add an official source document and record where it came from.

points.one: Accept official source documents, and use none of them until they are approved.

drafts.title: Draft / Diff
drafts.description: Work in progress, and how each piece differs from what is already approved.

points.one: Set a proposed version of a provision beside the version it would replace.

approve.title: Approve
approve.description: Decide what enters the corpus. Nothing is used until it is approved here.

points.one: Show each submitted source and provision with its checksum, and record who approved it and when.
Add IP facilitators and show who is available.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Your products, their classifications, and what is ready.

landing.lead: A guide to intellectual property and regulation for Ayurvedic products — being built to answer from official sources, to show the exact text it relied on, and to keep Indian and international law apart.
landing.status: Product profiles and the classifier work today. Cited answers and escalation to a facilitator come in later phases; curators are preparing the library of official sources, and nothing from it is shown to users yet.
landing.areasTitle: What works today, and what comes next

sources.title: Answers only from official text
sources.body: Every answer will quote the approved official text it relies on, with its source, version and date.

lanes.title: India and international, kept apart
lanes.body: Indian and international material are answered separately and never mixed.

abstain.title: Says so when it does not know
abstain.body: When the sources do not support an answer, it says so and offers a human facilitator instead.

profiles.title: Product profiles
profiles.body: Describe a product in your own words: purpose, form, ingredients, preparation.

classifier.title: Formulation classifier
classifier.body: Fixed, explainable questions lead to one of six categories, or stop at "I don't know".

corpus.title: Official source library
corpus.body: Curators upload official documents, read them and approve exact text. Nothing from it is shown to users yet.

answers.title: Cited answers
answers.body: Questions answered only from approved official text, with every quotation shown.

escalation.title: Human facilitators
escalation.body: Questions the sources cannot answer go to a person.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Use the account you were given. Your role decides what you see.
signIn.wrongProduct: This server is running a different product, so signing in here will not work.
signIn.demoNote: Synthetic accounts for the demonstration. Not real people.

lane.label: Lane
lane.hint: Indian and international material are kept apart. A record's lane is set once and never changes.

authority.label: Source authority
authority.hint: Only these official sources are accepted. Their reuse terms have not been verified.

issue.ocr_text_requires_verification: Some pages had no text layer and were read by OCR (machine transcription). Check them against the original.
issue.low_ocr_confidence: The OCR engine was unsure on some pages.
issue.page_without_text: Some pages yielded no text at all.
issue.ocr_unavailable: Some pages have no text layer, and no OCR engine was available to read them.

parseError.too_many_pages: The file has more pages than the limit. It was not read in part, because a partial text would look complete.
parseError.no_text_found: No text could be read from any page.
parseError.document_unreadable: The PDF could not be read.
parseError.incomplete_reading: Not every page could be read, so none of it was kept.
parseError.generic: The file could not be read.

list.empty: No source documents yet. Upload one to begin.
list.emptyLane: No source documents in this lane.

upload.instrumentHint: What this file is a text of: an Act, a set of Rules, a treaty.
upload.issuedByHint: The body that issued it, as the source names it.
upload.descriptionHint: Your own note about this record. Never statutory text.
upload.sourceUrlHint: Where you obtained the file. Recorded only — the server never opens it.
upload.sourceReferenceHint: A citation where there is no URL, such as a gazette number.
upload.fileHint: The file is stored exactly as uploaded. Nothing is read or approved until you choose to.
upload.provenanceNote: Give a URL, a reference, or both.

source.readHint: Copies the PDF's text layer exactly. Pages without one are read by the offline OCR engine and marked for checking.
source.emptyPage: No text was read from this page.
source.versionsTitle: Provision versions taken from this source
source.final: This decision is final. A correction is a new upload.

mark.title: Take a provision from this text
mark.help: Choose the first and last line of the provision. The text is copied exactly as read — nothing can be typed in.
mark.locator: Label as printed in the source
mark.locatorHint: For example 3(1), Article 15, or Schedule I item 4 — exactly as the source prints it.
mark.validityHint: When the source says this text applies. Both dates are inclusive. This is not the upload or approval date.

review.acknowledge: I checked the machine-read or missing text against the original file.
review.needsSource: Its source document must be approved first.

version.title: {locator} · version {number}
version.ocrWarning: Some of this text is OCR — machine transcription. Check it against the original before approving.
version.diffTitle: Compared with the last approved version
version.noBaseline: There is no earlier approved version of this provision. Every line is new.
version.statusNote: Each entry records what a cited source states, with that source. It is not the system's conclusion about the law.
version.basisHint: Give an approved source, a reference, or both.

diff.title: Compare
diff.noBaseline: There is no earlier approved source of this instrument. Every line is new.

queue.emptyDraftsBody: Uploaded sources and new provision versions appear here until they are submitted.
queue.emptyReviewBody: Sources and provision versions submitted for review appear here.

classifier.title: Support for the classifier
classifier.help: Link this approved text to a reference the classifier rests on. Only approved text in the same lane can be linked, and the link is recorded.
classifier.linked: Linked. The reference is now verified.
classifier.listHelp: What the classifier's questions rest on, and whether approved text supports each one yet.

stats.title: Corpus at a glance
stats.thisLane: Counts cover the chosen lane only.
stats.noApprovedBody: Nothing in the corpus can be quoted or used until a source is approved.

wizard.selectHint: Choose the lane first: it decides which instruments and authorities can be used, and it never changes.

lane.india: Indian Acts, Rules, notifications and other Indian sources.

wizard.fileHint: A PDF, stored exactly as uploaded.
wizard.drop: Drag a PDF here, or choose a file.
wizard.stored: Stored. The file is kept exactly as uploaded; nothing has been read or approved.
wizard.reviewHint: Check what was stored and read. To compare the text with the original, open the text review.
wizard.submitHint: Submitting sends the source for review. It is used only after a curator approves it.
wizard.submittedBody: A curator can now approve or reject it on Approve.

product.empty: Describe a product in your own words to classify it.
product.factsNote: These are your facts about your product, kept as you write them. They are not a classification and not a legal determination.

field.name: Product or formulation name
field.intended_use: What it is for, in your words
field.administration_route: How it is taken or applied
field.classical_reference: Classical text or formulation it follows, if any

product.noMatch: No products match the search or filter.

new.title: Add a product
new.description: Describe the product in your own words. Only the name is required.

product.editDescription: Saving makes a new version of the description. Earlier classifications keep the version they used.

validation.name: Give the product a name.
validation.ingredient: Name this ingredient, or remove the row.
validation.summary: Some details need attention before saving.

hint.name: The name you use for it.
hint.text_language: The language of what you write here. Your words are kept exactly as written.
hint.intended_use: In plain words. For example: taken daily as part of the diet.
hint.dosage_form: For example: tablet, oil, powder, syrup.
hint.administration_route: Choose "Not known" if you are not sure.
hint.ingredients: One ingredient per row. Leave out what you do not know.
hint.preparation_method: For example: the steps, heat or solvents used.
hint.classical_reference: Name the text and the formulation as you know them. This is your statement; it is not checked here.
hint.extract_description: For example: the plant part, the solvent and the ratio.
hint.standardization_description: For example: what it is standardised to, and how.
hint.notes: Anything else you want to keep with this description.

identity.title: Identity
identity.hint: What the product is called, and the language you write in.

form.title: Form and route
form.hint: Its form, and how it is taken or applied.

ingredients.title: Ingredients
ingredients.hint: What it contains, as far as you know.

classical.title: Classical reference
classical.hint: A classical text or formulation it follows, if any.

extract.title: Extract and standardisation
extract.hint: Only if the product is or contains an extract or fraction.

markers.title: Markers
markers.hint: Defined markers, if the extract has any.

state.not_classified: This product has not been classified. Answer up to four fixed questions to see which category your answers lead to.
state.in_progress: A classification is in progress. Continue where you left off.
state.requires_information: The last classification stopped at "I don't know". Nothing was assumed. Add what is missing, or change the answer.
state.awaiting_confirmation: The classifier reached a result from your answers. It waits for you to confirm it or say it does not fit.
state.confirmed: You confirmed this classification on {date}. It is your confirmation of the classifier's result, not a legal determination.

reference.verifiedNote: Linked by a curator to approved text in the source library.
reference.unverifiedNote: Linked, but to text that is not approved. It is not relied on.
reference.corpusRequiredNote: The official text for this has not been added to the source library yet, so nothing is cited.

purpose.question: What is the product's main purpose?
purpose.help: The purpose decides which group of rules the product is looked at under first.
purpose.why: Without it the classifier cannot tell which group of categories to consider.

hint.therapeutic: Choose this if the product is meant to have a therapeutic effect.
hint.nutrition: Choose this if it is meant to be eaten or drunk as food.
hint.external_beautification: Choose this if it is applied externally to cleanse or beautify.

classical_formula.question: Is the formula and method exactly as given in a text listed in the relevant First Schedule?
classical_formula.help: Answer yes only if you can name the listed text and the product follows its formula and method exactly.
classical_formula.missing: Whether the formula and method follow a listed text exactly.
classical_formula.why: This decides whether the product can be a classical formulation.

hint.yes: You can name the listed text, and the product follows its formula and method exactly.
hint.no: The formula or the method differs in any way, or no listed text applies.

schedule_combination.question: Does it contain only ingredients from the relevant First Schedule, in a new combination, and is it not given by injection or infusion?
schedule_combination.help: Answer yes only if all three are true. If any one is not, answer no.
schedule_combination.missing: Whether every ingredient is from the First Schedule, whether the combination is new, and how the product is given.
schedule_combination.why: This decides whether the product can be a patent or proprietary formulation.
schedule_combination.short: First Schedule ingredients, new combination, not injected

hint.no: At least one of the three is not true.

phytopharmaceutical.question: Is it a purified and standardised extract or fraction of a plant, with at least four defined markers?
phytopharmaceutical.help: Count only markers that are defined for this extract or fraction.
phytopharmaceutical.missing: Whether the product is a purified, standardised plant extract or fraction, and how many defined markers it has.
phytopharmaceutical.why: This decides whether the product can be a phytopharmaceutical.
phytopharmaceutical.short: Purified, standardised extract with four or more markers

hint.yes: It is a purified, standardised extract or fraction with at least four defined markers.
hint.no: It is not, or it has fewer than four defined markers.

slot.first_schedule: The First Schedule these questions refer to
slot.category_classical: The official description of a classical formulation
slot.category_patent_proprietary: The official description of a patent or proprietary formulation
slot.category_new_or_non_classical: The official basis for a new or non-classical formulation, if one exists
slot.category_phytopharmaceutical: The official description of a phytopharmaceutical
slot.category_ayurveda_aahara: The official description of Ayurveda Aahara
slot.category_cosmetic: The official description of a cosmetic

start.noProducts: Describe a product first, on My Product.

state.not_classified: Not classified yet. Starting opens a new classification with the classifier's current questions.
state.in_progress: A classification is in progress. Continue it where you left off.
state.requires_information: The classification in progress stopped at "I don't know". Continue it to change that answer.
state.awaiting_confirmation: A result is waiting for your confirmation.
state.confirmed: You have confirmed a classification. Starting again opens a new one and keeps the old one.

how.one: Answer up to four fixed questions, one at a time.
how.two: "I don't know" stops the questions and says what is missing.
how.three: Confirm the result, or say it does not fit.

session.title: Classifying {product}
session.tree: Classifier version {version} · engineering draft, not yet legally reviewed
session.context: What you told us about the product
session.noContext: You have not described this yet.
session.resultNote: This is the category the classifier's fixed questions lead to from your answers. It is not a legal determination, not an approval, and not advice.
session.reject: This does not fit — reject it
session.rejectedNote: No other category was chosen in its place. To revise your answers, start again.
session.superseded: This classification was replaced by a newer one. It is kept as it was.

flow.stepNote: Some answers finish sooner, so you may not see every step.
flow.changingNote: Changing an answer can change which questions come after it.
flow.unknownHint: Choose this if you are not sure. The classification stops and says what is missing. Nothing is assumed.
flow.restartHint: Starting again keeps this classification as it is and opens a new one.

unknown.title: More information is needed
unknown.lead: You answered "I don't know", so the classification stopped here.
unknown.assumed: Nothing has been assumed, and no category has been chosen.

result.question: Does this match your product?
result.changeTitle: What do you want to change?
result.rejectNote: Rejecting picks no other category. The product stays unclassified until you classify it again.

timeline.title: Classification history
timeline.hint: Every classification of this product, newest first. Nothing here can be changed.
timeline.restart: Started again from an earlier classification

demo.title: Demo mode
demo.body: This is a demonstration server. Some of what you see is synthetic, made up for the demonstration:

points.accounts: The sign-in accounts are synthetic, one per role. They are not real people.
points.samples: A sample product, if you load one, is synthetic and labelled "DEMO DATA" wherever it appears.
points.never: No legal text, statute, citation or government information is ever synthetic. The source library holds only what curators add from official sources.

hero.title: Understand your product's intellectual-property and regulatory landscape.
hero.lead: Describe a product in your own words, classify it with fixed, explainable questions, and — once the source library is connected — ask questions answered only from cited official text.

readiness.title: Readiness
readiness.hint: What is in place for your products today.
readiness.productDone: At least one product is described.
readiness.classificationDone: At least one classification is confirmed by you.
readiness.classificationTodo: No classification has been confirmed yet.
readiness.corpusNote: {verified} of {total} classifier references are backed by approved official text.
readiness.answersNote: Not available yet. It is built in a later phase.

recent.title: Recent classification
recent.empty: No classification yet. Classify a product to see its result here.

references.title: Reference status
references.hint: The legal references the classifier's questions rest on.

start.title: Getting started
start.oneBody: Its name, purpose, form and ingredients, in your own words.
start.twoBody: Up to four fixed questions. "I don't know" is always an answer.
start.threeBody: A result is only a proposal until you confirm it.
start.fourBody: Answers quoted from official sources, with India and international kept apart.

ask.title: Ask Sahayak
ask.description: Ask a question about intellectual property or regulation for an Ayurvedic product.

notEnabled.title: The answer service is not enabled yet
notEnabled.body: You can prepare a question here, but it will not be sent and no answer will be generated. Cited answers come in a later phase, built only from approved official text.

ask.question: Your question
ask.questionHint: One topic at a time works best. For example: which kinds of protection could apply to a product name?
ask.productHint: Answers will be able to take your product's description into account.
ask.asOfHint: The law is read as it stood on this date.
ask.jurisdictionHint: India and international material are always answered separately, never mixed. Choose one or both.
ask.languageHint: Quoted legal text is always shown in its original language, never machine-translated.
ask.notSentNote: Nothing you type here is sent while the answer service is off.

held.title: Your question was not sent
held.body: The source-grounded answer service is not enabled in this version, so no answer was generated. Your question is still here.

empty.title: No answer yet
empty.body: Cited answers will appear here once the source-grounded knowledge service is enabled.

validation.question: Write a question first.
validation.future: The date cannot be in the future.

india.title: Indian law and regulation
india.scope: Only from approved Indian sources: India Code, e-Gazette, IP India, National Biodiversity Authority and FSSAI.

international.title: International instruments
international.scope: Only from approved international sources: WIPO Lex.

confidence.insufficient: Not enough support — no answer given

citation.ocr: Part of this text was read by OCR and checked by a curator against the original.

escalate.title: Ask a person
escalate.body: A human IP facilitator can look at a question the sources do not answer.
escalate.later: Escalation opens in a later release.

empty.title: No escalations yet.
empty.body: When a user sends a question to a facilitator, it will arrive here with what the sources did and did not support.

empty.title: No escalation selected.
empty.body: A brief brings together one escalation: the question, the user's product and the sources already found.

sections.question: The question
sections.notCovered: What the sources did not cover

brief.pending: Shown when an escalation is opened.

select.title: No conversation selected.
select.body: Conversations with users will appear here once escalation is available.

messages.reply: Replies will be written here and shown to the user as yours, with your name and role.

empty.title: No notes yet.
empty.body: Working notes on an escalation will be kept here. Only facilitators will see them.

empty.title: No facilitators have been added yet.
empty.body: Adding facilitators, approving them and seeing their activity opens in a later release.

demo.title: Demo accounts
demo.body: Synthetic accounts created by the demo seed, one per role. Listed from this app's configuration, not read from the server. They are not real people.
